title: Sharing your information
intro: Before the wallet shows anything, please read how your information is used.
summaryWhatBody: Results and next steps your care team has reviewed and released, your reminders and a timeline.
summaryWhoBody: You, or your legal representative, on this device. Your care team keeps your record at the facility.
summaryWithdrawBody: Any time: More → Consent → Stop sharing. The wallet then hides everything straight away.
noticeBody1: This is a demonstration. All people and records are made up. No real information is collected or sent anywhere.
noticeBody2: The wallet only shows information your care team has released to you. It never gives a diagnosis or treatment advice.
noticeBody3: Each time your record is viewed, the access is recorded so you can see it later.
conflict: Your consent was changed elsewhere. Here is the latest.
saveError: Your consent could not be saved. Nothing was changed. Try again.
noRecordBody: Your care team has not linked a health record to this account yet. They do this with you at the facility. Nothing is shown until then.
withdrawnBody: You stopped sharing. Your care team still has your record; this app no longer shows it.
stateGranted: You are sharing your information with this wallet.
stateWithdrawn: You are not sharing your information.
stateNone: You have not given consent yet.
confirmBody: The wallet will stop showing your results, next steps, reminders and timeline straight away, and scheduled reminders are cancelled. Your clinical record is not deleted — your care team still has it. You can give consent again at any time.
withdrawError: Sharing could not be stopped. Nothing was changed. Try again.
